::: {#hero-heading}
I am Basant Saud, an **Animal Science and Veterinary Medicine** graduate with MS in **Veterinary Pathology**. Currently, I am a Research Assistant in the the lab of [Amina Khatun, PhD,](https://sau.edu.bd/teacher/261){target="_blank"} [Department of Pathology](https://sau.edu.bd/department/pathology){target="_blank"}, [Sher-e-Bangla Agricultural University](https://sau.edu.bd/){target="_blank"}, Bangladesh.

My research interests are Virology, Immunology, Epidemiology, Multiomics, Zoonoses and One health.

:::
